etymologies.etymologyHTML: From social +‎ -ist.

definitions.definition: Of, relating to, supporting, or advocating socialism.

quote.citation: 1848, John Stuart Mill, Principles of Political Economy, Book II, Chapter 1:
quote.text: ...it must be remembered that in a Socialist farm or manufactory, each labourer would be under the eye not of one master, but of the whole community.

quote.citation: 1949 May, Albert Einstein, “Why Socialism?”, in Monthly Review:
quote.text: I am convinced there is only one way to eliminate these grave evils, namely through the establishment of a socialist economy, accompanied by an educational system which would be oriented toward social goals.

definitions.definition: One who supports or advocates socialism.

quote.citation: 1848, John Stuart Mill, Principles of Political Economy, Book II, Chapter 1:
quote.text: A contest, who can do most for the common good, is not the kind of competition which Socialists repudiate.
